summary: The mayor asks how the city will know whether an alternative keeps discarded containers off the streets.
realLife: Hindman wanted assurance that Columbia could control beverage litter at least as well before changing its ordinance.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: comparable litter observations.

turns.what: The mayor asks staff to walk the same streets after implementation.
turns.pulledBy: Inspectors have a baseline for the same streets.
turns.writesBack: The council can request a comparable count after a change.

turns.what: A sanitation worker explains why a full truck says little about litter left on the curb.
turns.pulledBy: The count covers only material picked up at the curb.
turns.writesBack: The mayor asks for street observations before drawing a conclusion.
